relevance.why: Token cost is a real constraint for a solo founder on Claude Code. A near-parity open-weight model at ~5% of the price matters for bulk/sub-agent work, even if Claude Code itself stays on Anthropic models.

implement_score.why: Worth a cheap experiment: route high-volume, low-risk tasks (summaries, test generation, data cleaning) to DeepSeek V4 Pro via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Do not swap primary coding model on one benchmark.
